mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a mild 56 degrees under overcast skies along the Military Ridge State Trail. The moon is a Waxing Gibbous, and we are expecting a clear view of the ISS tonight starting at 8:30 PM as it travels from the Northwest near Verona High School toward the East.

The city has announced that road crack filling begins on September 28, so please use caution in work zones on streets like South Nine Mound Road. Additionally, you can stay updated on city projects by subscribing to the official Verona newsletter.

There is plenty to do in our community today, starting with trivia at both Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park or join the fun at Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory.
In our weekly police update, officers reported an unusual incident on September 5 where multiple vehicles were found with slices of cheese on their windshields as part of a social media prank.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for a building remodel, so there is no flavor of the day available at this time.
